Warnings array is empty for well-formed HTML without problematic content

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>Clean content with <a href='https://example.com'>a link</a>.</p>", ConversionOptions())
    println(result.content)
    println(result.warnings)
}
```
